name: Nara Wildmane
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Requires level 10 instead of 12. From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I entered the land of dreams, and dreamed of a cult of druids who dwell in the Wailing Caverns.  I saw that their goals were once noble, but they have lost their way.  They are now servants of the taint seeping through the Barrens.

I am old and my strength fails.  I could not long dwell in that dreaming place and know little more of the tainted druids.  But Nara is young and her spirit is fierce.  She remained in the dreaming when I fled.

Speak with Nara.  She is in the tent, over yonder.
narrative.offerRewardText: Yes, it is true. I know of the druids in the Wailing Caverns. I have seen their twisted, scaled faces. I know their crimes, and I know their plans.You must stop them, adventurer.

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 10 to 22, 7,770 XP in all.

quests.name: The Barrens Oases
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads.

quests.name: The Forgotten Pools
quests.objectiveText: Report back to Tonga Runetotem with your findings.

quests.name: The Stagnant Oasis
quests.objectiveText: Return to Tonga at The Crossroads, after investigating the Stagnant Oasis.

quests.name: Altered Beings
quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 Altered Snapjaw Shells to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads.

quests.name: Leaders of the Fang
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Gems of Cobrahn, Anacondra, Pythas and Serpentis to Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.
